places-cueva-del-gitano-cueva-de-la-plat.story: A 262 km round trip from Nerpio - roughly 4 h 31 in the saddle. The stops in between: Central E. de Santonje, Cueva de la Plata and back through Central E. de Santonje. The highest point is about 1,350 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Paso de los Libertadores
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 14 km this is Paso de los Libertadores, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.
